hero.title: How the inspection works
hero.text: Book an inspection online. We’ll take care of the car and send you clear results.

step1.title: Choose a service and time.
step1.text: When booking, provide the car’s location and the seller’s contact details. Then wait for your confirmation email.

step2.title: We’ll inspect the car.
step2.text: Our specialist will meet the car at the location you provide and carry out your chosen inspection. A full inspection includes a test drive when conditions allow.

step3.title: Get your inspection results.
step3.text: After a full inspection, we’ll send photos, a summary of any issues, and a clear conclusion. We’ll briefly explain diagnostic results.
